# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion: Check what results the test failed on. 3. Look for the accepted ranges shown on the Pass column on the right. 4. Construct the sentence using the following format: `The left (or right) front brake test result is over (or under) {value}. The actual value is {value}.`. 5. Here are two examples: - The left front brake test result is under 20 N. The actual value is 15.5 N. - The right rear brake test result is over 40 N. The actual value is 43.8 N.
